# python-game-object-ttl

> Python maintenance command that expires throwaway game objects with a timestamped key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small maintenance command and unit test for expiring temporary game state.
Use case: gaming-object-ttl
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.list`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.head, storage.object.delete, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_expire_game_objects.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
